sonnet.problem: This story card sets up the true/false question on card 6 (do they settle it and keep traveling together?) and gives away the answer. It says the disagreement is 'SO sharp' and calls it 'an argument nobody's backing down from', which tells the baker they won't settle it. Card 6's own question also says they 'can't agree'.
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.
